messages:
Sophia Patel: Quick idea: add a tiny "steward" in the edge proxy for ultra-low-latency token checks + short leases. Local leaky bucket + central reconcile. Thoughts?

Tom Nguyen: Sounds useful. Main risk is multi-edge amplification if tenants open many connections. Need hard per-steward caps.

Devin Brooks: Implementation: steward keeps local_tokens and asks broker for short leases (200-1000ms) when burst over local reserve. If broker slow -> enforce conservative fallback.

Carla Mendez: Telemetry required: steward.request, steward.grant, steward.revoke, steward.local_drop. Include steward_id and lease_id.

Priya Shah: Abuse vectors: distributed clients spread across edges. Mitigations: require per-tenant issuance tokens, fingerprint connections, and use global sketches to estimate unique edges.

Akash Rao: Sketch idea: stewards push CountMin/HyperLogLog deltas to broker periodically. Broker NACKs leases if estimated distinct connections > threshold. Low bandwidth.

Tom Nguyen: API sketch:
POST /v1/lease
{tenant, requested_tokens, steward_id}
200 {granted, lease_id, expires_ms}
Fallback: if no response in 100ms steward applies conservative cap.

Devin Brooks: Use lease_id + idempotency seq to avoid double-counting on reconnects. Broker must support revoke message to reclaim tokens.

Carla Mendez: Security: mTLS + signed attestation. TTL short and auditable. Telemetry events HMAC'd with rotated keys.

Priya Shah: Detection rules to add: cross-edge_ratio spike, steward_denial_rate spike, fingerprint churn. Map to soft-shed policies.

Sophia Patel: Rollout: shadow mode -> soft-enforce 1% -> ramp. Central kill switch to revoke all leases. Migration docs for tenants.

Akash Rao: Implementation note: keep steward state tiny (map of recent leases). Prefer gRPC streaming for lease flow. Batch sketch reports.

Tom Nguyen: I'll run a small sim: edges=200, tenants=10k, attackers=500 to verify amplification bounds.

rls-bot: deploy-notifier: steward-canary pushed to staging (image: infra/steward:canary-203).
